# Retap Media

> Retap Media LLC (Florida) builds appointment systems for home-services
> companies. Core offer: database reactivation — compliant SMS/email campaigns
> that turn the leads a business already paid for into booked, qualified,
> sat appointments — plus under-60-second speed-to-lead follow-up, an AI
> receptionist, booking/nurture funnels, and conversion websites. Everything
> plugs into the client's existing CRM; no new ad spend required.

Founded by Preston Whitty and Patrick Viau. Works with businesses holding
500+ leads in their database. Appointments are counted as qualified sits
(reconfirmed, transcript attached; no-shows replaced, not tallied) and every
engagement carries a written outcome guarantee. Compliance model: carrier-
registered numbers in the client's name, first-party lists only, instant
opt-out honoring, business-hours sending, client-owned consent and message
logs.

## Verticals

- Residential solar (live): The Solar Appointment Engine — https://solaraiflow.com/
  Offer: 10+ qualified, sat appointments within the first 90 days of launch,
  guaranteed in writing, from the installer's existing lead database.
- Pools & spas: opening next (September–February buying season)
- Generator dealers: in build queue
- HVAC: in build queue
